notes: Quick Stack & Sort costs the server much less while you mine on a nearly full inventory page: auto-store moves pickups at most once a second, all together.
Fishing costs the server much less: one pack follows each bobber and shares every catch with Skills, the Journal, Daily Quests and Story Questlines.
Side HUD: the right-side boxes now show on short phone screens when the Minimap radar is hidden.
Rain Charm and Tide Boots now work on beaches and on sandstone paths in the rain.
Story Blood Moons and Harvest Moons never come two nights in a row, and never replace a moon an operator chose.
Mining the same stone spot again within 5 minutes gives no Mining XP, so cobblestone and basalt generators do not farm it.
The sky-wonder bonus in Frogs in Three Voices also works with Rainbows, Tornadoes or Storm Cells.
Town Projects residents can no longer breed.

Townsfolk cost the server much less, most of all with many players online away from town; a townsfolk standing next to an armor stand, painting or pet no longer has its name label flicker every 10 seconds.

Minimap radar: a full terrain cache no longer leaves radars blank for minutes after a big scan, and costs the server less while players travel; players can scan up to 128 blocks with /realm:minimap scan (operators 384).
resourceNotes: Side HUD: the right-side boxes start right under the compass when the Minimap radar is hidden, so they show on short phone screens.

hud_rp.notes: The right-side boxes start right under the compass when the Minimap radar is hidden, so they show on short phone screens.

relics_bp.notes: Rain Charm and Tide Boots count natural sand, red sand, terracotta, snow and ice as dry ground only; sandstone, glazed terracotta, stairs and slabs do not, and sand next to water (a beach) counts as rained on.

moon_bp.notes: A story request never overrides a moon an operator chose tonight (even an ordinary one) and never follows a moon night; moon:night now saves op and p.

skills_bp.notes: Fishing XP counts the catches Fishing Rewards reports, instead of following every bobber again (when Fishing Rewards is installed).

town_bp.notes: Residents can no longer breed; leftovers from Remove spot are capped apart from the town limit; the realm:town_test hook needs the realm_test_hooks objective.

saga_bp.notes: Shared name label update: a label is taken down only 4 blocks past its range, so it no longer flickers for a player standing at the edge.

maps_bp.notes: Searches take turns so one long search cannot starve the others, a marker is built whole or not at all, and a record whose hunt owner never comes back is let go after 60 days.

platypus_bp.notes: A bite no longer throws an error when the event data is missing.

stash_bp.notes: Auto-store moves pickups to your other pages at most once a second (several pickups in one save) and looks only after an inventory change; a lost page button is put back within 30 s instead of 5 s. The pack reads and saves its page index and retired-snapshot list far less often.

npc_bp.notes: Much cheaper on the server: every player is read once per check (not once per townsfolk), and a standing townsfolk's label needs no reads of it. Its name label no longer flickers every 10 seconds when an armor stand, painting or pet stands next to it. Townsfolk turn toward you in steps of 10 degrees or more.

wander_bp.notes: Cheaper on the server: the once-a-minute roll comes before the look around for old stones at night, and the name labels read less between checks.

titles_bp.notes: The config comment lists every trail a built-in title can unlock.

fishing_bp.notes: Casting a rod costs the server much less: the light-block check for Dynamic Lightning now runs only on a new bobber and only when that add-on is installed, and where a catch happened is worked out once a minute per spot. Every catch is now shared with the packs that count catches.

journal_bp.notes: The fish page counts the catches Fishing Rewards reports, instead of following every bobber again (when Fishing Rewards is installed).

quests_bp.notes: Fish quests count the catches Fishing Rewards reports, instead of following every bobber again (when Fishing Rewards is installed).

caravan_bp.notes: Cheaper on the server: the schedule is read from the world once a minute, not every 2 seconds. Traders turn toward you in steps of 10 degrees or more.

map_bp.notes: The radar keeps filling in when its terrain cache is full or over its cap (after a big scan or when players leave), plans travel at the cap far more cheaply, and frees terrain nobody has looked at for 5 minutes. /realm:minimap scan is limited to radius 128 for players (operators keep 384).
